Recovered S1 four 46,XY karyotype panels inspected; images alone do not rule out cryptic structural variants. S2 all displayed ortholog alignments read: R125/A295/V273/V395 conservation supports constraint but not clinical causality; several nonmammal substitutions and one deletion row visible.

S3 qPCR graph: vector approximately 1, WT approximately 49, R125L mutant approximately 41 relative mRNA; error bars present without plotted N/P labels. Both overexpress strongly, mutant less than WT. This does not show equivalent protein doses or endogenous loss of function, and does not eliminate overexpression toxicity.

All S1–S8 tables read, including every alternate-candidate row. F154 brothers share homozygous NPHP4 c.2818-2T>A splice, NEMF p.S257C, AGAP3 p.C32G and others; IV:1 additionally MAP3K14 p.S902X, IV:3 NACA2 p.R197X and TCEA3 splice among candidates. No segregation/functional exclusion of these alternatives supplied in tables. Their labels potential pathogenic are hypotheses, not adjudicated diagnoses.

F208 Table S5 alternatives include SLC25A5 frameshift plus missense, KMT5A/SETD8 missense pair, FLNC pair, ABCA13 pair and others; X-linked loci sometimes labeled Hom./Het. without a sex-aware interpretation. F230 S6 includes LIG3 pair, IGSF3 stop plus missense, EGLN1 frameshift plus missense, TEKT1 pair, and others. Phase of these alternate pairs is not shown; do not treat all listed double heterozygotes as in trans.

ATG4D Table S3/S4 transcript NM_032885.5 rather than main .6, same c374G>T. S5 reports isoform-dependent V210I/V332M on NM_001281504 versus V273I/V395M on NM_032885. S6 deletion c9_23del annotated only NM_001281504, contrasting main/primer NM_032885.6; protein p3_8del nomenclature remains unresolved.

S7 ATG4A c923G>A gnomADall4.582e-5 and ExAC EAsian.0005; ATG4B c331G>A ExAC EAsian.001 and c944C>T gnomAD EAsian.0006. NA is not absence. S8 ATG4A LRT neutral, ATG4B c331G>A PROVEAN tolerable/CADD13.89, underscoring mixed computational evidence rather than universal pathogenicity. No new patient phenotype data in these tables.
